{{Quote|You have proved to be the top of your class, and so now is the time of The Gathering. For a Jedi, there is no greater challenge or honor.|Ahsoka Tano|<ref name="The Gathering" />}}
A '''clan''' of six [[Jedi Initiate|Jedi younglings]] were training to become a [[Jedi]] in the [[Jedi Order]] during the [[Clone Wars]]. During the war, the [[Clan (Jedi)|clan]] of younglings were deemed to be at the top of their class and, led by [[Ahsoka Tano]], they traveled to [[Ilum]] to participate in [[Gathering|the Gathering]]; an ancient Jedi ritual that proved a youngling's readiness to become [[Padawan]]s.<ref name="The Gathering" /> This particular clan, never identified by name, consisted of [[Petro]] (a [[human]] [[Gender|male]]), [[Ganodi]] (a [[Rodian]] female), [[Katooni]] (a [[Tholothian]] female), [[Byph]] (an [[Ithorian]] male), [[Zatt]] (a [[Nautolan]] male), and [[Gungi]] (a [[Wookiee]] male).
